column7: Contactor position, preferred source and source availability.
column15: bit 0 = Contactor position bit 0 (bits 0-1: 00 = off, 01 = normal, 10 = emergency, 11 = fault); bit 1 = Contactor position bit 1; bit 2 = Preferred source: 0 = source 1, 1 = source 2; bit 3 = Bits 3-12: top event on the warning stack; bit 13 = Preferred source available; bit 14 = Standby source available
bit 0 = Source A bit 0 (bits 0-1: 01 = ABC, 00 = CBA, 10 = N/A, 11 = error); bit 1 = Source A bit 1; bit 2 = Source B bit 0 (bits 2-3: same coding); bit 3 = Source B bit 1

column7: Main logic board I/O, one bit each.
column15: bit 0 = Programmable output; bit 1 = Programmable input 1; bit 2 = Programmable input 2; bit 3 = Fixed output LSDO; bit 4 = Fixed output source 2 engine start
bit 0 = Exercise in progress; bit 1 = In-phase monitor active; bit 2 = Load shed in progress; bit 3 = Peak shaving in progress; bit 4 = Test occurring
bit 0 = Transfer inhibited; bit 1 = Loaded/unloaded test; bit 2 = Exercise inhibited; bit 3 = Loaded exercise (push button only); bit 4 = Exercise interval 2 weeks (push button only)

column7: High byte = major, low byte = minor version.

column15: bit 0 = Reset maintenance records; bit 1 = Start peak shave; bit 2 = End peak shave; bit 3 = Start remote test; bit 4 = End remote test; bit 5 = Force transfer to OFF; bit 6 = Resume programmed transition operation; bit 7 = End current time delay; bit 8 = Remote manual exercise start; bit 9 = Remote manual exercise end
